summary: Iteration 3 — Dudas (respuestas, ratings 1-5, aceptar) and Asesorías (agenda, cupos, bookings, incoming states) fully validated. 28/28 backend pytest cases pass; UI flows for both student and monitor demo logins, question creation, question detail, monitor advisory creation, and all 5 SPA routes verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 537 lines and starting to feel monolithic; consider splitting Dudas / Asesorías / Files routers into modules once it crosses ~700 lines.
Startup seed uses hardcoded advisor id 'demo-professor-rojas' with no matching user, so PATCH/DELETE on 'adv-2' can never be exercised by a real advisor. Purely cosmetic seed data.
AI model 'gpt-5.4-mini' hardcoded in server.py; ensure this is intentional and available under the current Emergent LLM key.
test_credentials: estudiante@uao.edu.co / UAOdemo2026! ; monitor@uao.edu.co / UAOdemo2026! (also POST /api/auth/demo and /api/auth/demo-advisor).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed questions, one TEST_ registered student (student2), and several UITEST advisories/bookings that remain in the preview database. No production/seed data was mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered end-to-end: auth demo/me, questions create/answer/rate(own-403/out-of-range-422)/accept(non-owner-403), advisories create(student-403)/list(mine + booked/available)/patch/delete(owner-only), bookings create(dup 409, cupo-lleno 409, self-advisor 409)/list/incoming(student empty)/status transitions (accept, invalid 422, student non-cancel 403, cancel 200). UI verified: demo-login-button, demo-advisor-button, /dudas new-question-button + question-title/description/subject-input + submit-question-button, question detail loads with answer-body-input, /asesorias tabs (tab-browse/tab-mine for student, tab-agenda/tab-incoming for monitor), new-advisory-button opens form and advisory-form-submit creates row visible under agenda. All 5 SPA routes (/dudas, /asignaturas, /asesorias, /chat, /asistente-ia) load 200 with no console errors. Google login remains a mocked configuration message; chat uses 5s polling (no WS). Only note: main-agent request mentioned 'question-body-input' but the actual selector in Questions.jsx is 'question-description-input' — kept as-is (no bug).
rca of the issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
